mainEntity.name: What types of materials are commonly used for exterior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for exterior trim include wood (cedar, redwood, pine), engineered wood, PVC, fiber cement, and composite. Wood offers a classic look but requires regular maintenance. Engineered wood provides stability and resistance to rot. PVC is a low-maintenance, rot-proof option, often mimicking wood. Fiber cement is durable, fire-resistant, and comes in various textures. Composites blend plastic and wood fibers, offering good durability. Each material has different characteristics regarding cost, maintenance, and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior trim uses materials like wood, engineered wood, PVC, fiber cement, and composite, each offering different durability, maintenance, and aesthetic qualities.
